calls.body: SELECT 'sum' AS kind, MetricName FROM `default`.`otel_metrics_sum` WHERE TimeUnix >= toDateTime(1791746400) AND TimeUnix < toDateTime(1791750060) GROUP BY MetricName UNION ALL SELECT 'gauge', MetricName FROM `default`.`otel_metrics_gauge` WHERE TimeUnix >= toDateTime(1791746400) AND TimeUnix < toDateTime(1791750060) GROUP BY MetricName UNION ALL SELECT 'histogram', MetricName FROM `default`.`otel_metrics_histogram` WHERE TimeUnix >= toDateTime(1791746400) AND TimeUnix < toDateTime(1791750060) GROUP BY MetricName
